title: Secure a business loan or credit facility
summary: When the company is evaluating debt to fund a specific operating or investment need. An approved financing decision and, if accepted, a reconciled funded facility with an obligations calendar.
outcomes: An approved financing decision and, if accepted, a reconciled funded facility with an obligations calendar.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company is evaluating debt to fund a specific operating or investment need.

parts.title: Define the borrowing need and repayment case
parts.guidance: Prepare the cash requirement, use of proceeds, forecast repayments and downside scenario. Compare debt with available cash and equity alternatives without assuming a loan program or guarantee is available.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assemble the lender diligence pack
parts.guidance: Gather financial statements, ownership records, existing debt, collateral information and forecast assumptions. Track lender-specific requests and verify the lender and application channel before sharing confidential records.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review terms and select an offer
parts.guidance: Finance leadership and counsel review interest mechanics, fees, security, guarantees, covenants, default terms and prepayment rules. Record the total obligations and who has authority to commit the company or provide a guarantee.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review terms and select an offer

parts.title: Approve and execute the financing documents
parts.guidance: Obtain required corporate and personal approvals for the final terms. The authorized people execute the documents and funding instructions; no guarantee or collateral commitment is assumed from an application alone.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve and execute the financing documents

parts.title: Reconcile funding and register ongoing obligations
parts.guidance: Verify funds received, fees and opening balances against the signed documents. Calendar repayments, covenant tests and notice requirements and assign reporting owners before treating the facility as available cash.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An approved financing decision and, if accepted, a reconciled funded facility with an obligations calendar.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
